The Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship offers a comprehensive package that includes tuition waivers, accommodation, airfare, and a generous stipend, providing aspiring scholars with the opportunity to thrive in their academic pursuits.

The scholarship is applicable to international applicants pursuing master’s, and doctoral studies.

Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship Abstract

  • Scholarship Host: Chinese Government

  • Study Abroad: Study Abroad || Study-In-Asia 

  • Location: China

  • Category: Scholarships ||  Postgraduate Scholarships || Masters Scholarships || PhD Scholarships 

  • Benefits: Full Scholarship

    • Tuition

    • Accommodation

    • ¥45,000 Stipend/Yr 

    • Travel Expenses

  • Eligibility: All Countries

  • Deadline: Varies by institution

Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship Details

The Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship is a proof of China’s commitment to fostering international cooperation and talent development.

Through this scholarship program, the Ministry of Commerce aims to strengthen communication and collaboration between China and other nations while nurturing future leaders from developing countries.

With its focus on postgraduate studies, including master’s and doctoral programs, the scholarship opens doors to a world of academic excellence and research opportunities.

Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship Benefits

  • Students are exempt from tuition fee, teaching material fee, research and survey fee, allowance of English-taught program, dissertation guidance fee;

  • Free on-campus accommodation;

  • Monthly stipend:

    • 36000RMB per year per master student,

    • 42000RMB per year per PhD student;One-off resettlement fee: 3000RMB per person;

  • Free medical insurance for international students;

  • One-time round-trip international airfare for all the students (First time fly to China after enrollment, and Fly back to home country while graduation), 

  • The annual review is compulsory for all students. Those who pass the review may continue to enjoy full scholarships in the next year.

  • Other expenses shall be managed and used by the Ministry of Commerce or the universities as a whole, and shall not be distributed to students.

Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the postgraduate Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Be a citizen of a developing country other than the People’s Republic of China, and under the age of 45 (born after September 1, 1974)

  • Be in good health

  • Have at least three years’  working experience

  • Be a bachelor’s degree holder when applying for master’s program;

  • Be a master’s degree holder when applying for doctoral program;

  • Have sufficient English or Chinese proficiency which meets the academic requirements of the program.

Required Documents for MOFCOM Scholarship

While applying for the 2026 Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarships, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Application Form for MOFCOM Scholarship-CSC Program;

  • Photocopy of highest diploma

  • Photocopy of academic transcripts

  • A Study Plan or Research Proposal, plus a resume including the  educational background and working experience after high school

  • Two recommendation letters, including one from current employer and one from academic perspective;

  • Photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.

  • Photocopy of the English proficiency certificate;

  • Photocopy of a valid passport;

  • Non-criminal Record Report.

How To Apply for Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship

To apply for the Chinese Government MOFCOM Scholarship, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Click on the button below to visit the MOFCOM Scholarship webpage

  • Apply to any Chinese university of their choice.

  • Visit www.csc.edu.cn/studyinchina or https://www.campuschina.org

  • Register an account through [CREATE AN ACCOUNT] and login with your account.

  •  Click “Edit Personal Details” and finish inputting personal details by filling in all the information, verifying and saving the information.

  • After the completion of this section, return to the previous page by clicking “Finish” and start filling in your application information.

  • Select the correct “Program Category”

  • Input your Agency Number is: 00010. (Only for applicants of MOFCOM Scholarship-CSC Program)

  • Upload “Supporting Documents” as requested, then click “Submit” to complete the application.
